study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Xiao et al., Biological Psychiatry: Global Open Science, 2025
study_identification_part.si4_title: Deviations From Normative Functioning Underlying Emotional Episodic Memory Revealed Cross-Scale Neurodiverse Alterations Linked to Affective Symptoms in Distinct Psychiatric Disorders

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Build a task-fMRI normative reference for emotional episodic memory activation from healthy participants and quantify individualized deviations in MDD, BD, and SZ; embed deviations into emotional networks and link them to affective symptoms and transcriptomic cell-type signatures.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Individual deviation features predicted affective symptoms within each disorder (HAMD in MDD and BD; PANSS in SZ), reporting correlation between observed and predicted scores; virtual lesion analysis assessed feature importance.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Distinct, non-overlapping emotional network deviations associate with affective symptoms across MDD, BD, and SZ; oligodendrocytes show transdiagnostic linkage, with disorder-specific enrichment in microglia (MDD), astrocytes (BD), and excitatory neurons (SZ).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Individualized deviations during emotional memory retrieval show increased proportions of extreme deviations at the network level relative to regional level. MDD exhibits hyperactivations in emotion perception/generation networks; SZ shows abnormalities in working memory/response inhibition networks; BD displays dysfunctions spanning emotional reactivity and cognition. Predictive models using deviations correlate with affective symptom scores. Imaging-transcriptomic analyses identify oligodendrocyte-related convergence and disorder-specific cell-type associations.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Network-level deviation mapping may guide state-specific psychotherapeutic strategies; deviation-derived features show utility for symptom prediction; circuit-level deviations align with emotional networks via PPI/lesion network mapping.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Relatively small clinical sample sizes for transdiagnostic analyses; non-overlapping symptom measures across disorders; partial missing HAMD components in BD; BD mostly euthymic; potential medication confounding despite sensitivity analyses; AHBA left-hemisphere-only coverage and donor limitations; indirect inference between imaging and transcriptomic datasets.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Two in-house datasets on GE MR750 scanners at Peking University used for HC reference and clinical application. Normative model predicts regional activation from task performance metrics; age/sex included in stability checks. Modeling algorithm/software for normative modeling not explicitly named; evaluation used 10-fold CV, SMSE, and MSLL.
